niche.habitat: Dry Kiln plains, near sulfur fumaroles and fulgurite glass fields.
niche.diet: Abiotic chemosynthesis mats, salt-fused glass shards, sulfur fumarole gas.
niche.active: Staggered by thermal comfort; active when ground <310K, rests in shade of rocks.

body: Armored hexagonal plates, fulgurite-cracker beak, heat-sink tail, flare-responsive pupils.

skill.effect: Immune to Kiln heat damage; reduce 'Overheat' risk by 50%.

chains.weakness: Cold shock; player can use ice/cool skill to stun or slow Cenizo.
observe: Plates glowing dull red in heat, then flashing white in shade
Cenizo burying tail in cooler sand
Heat shimmer distorting view of resting Cenizo

plausibility.summary: Specify NIR-reflective cuticle/scutes, not just ‘white’; tie activity to ground <310 K and shade/burrow tail use; narrow immunity to brief surface exposure, not indefinite 320 K contact.
fixes: Specify NIR-reflective cuticle/scutes, not just ‘white’; tie activity to ground <310 K and shade/burrow tail use; narrow immunity to brief surface exposure, not indefinite 320 K contact.

links: Stagnant lid volcanism strings fumaroles along ring

skill.effect: Deal 6 acid damage in cone; heals Cenizo based on damage dealt.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to wind shifts that invert H₂S plume; player can use wind skill to blow gas back.
observe: Cenizo pressing snout to fumarole vent
Fumarole activity increasing near Cenizo nest

plausibility.summary: Fumarole H₂S along the ring (F21) supports chemolithotrophic microbes; hosts with sulfur-oxidizing symbionts or fermentation of sulfurous mats is standard vent-shore ecology. A territorial Kiln forager eating mats plus tapping fumarole gas is energetically plausible as supplement, not sole autotrophy. Wind inversion blowing H₂S back is a real toxicity risk above ~100 ppm (F27).
fixes: Fumarole H₂S along the ring (F21) supports chemolithotrophic microbes; hosts with sulfur-oxidizing symbionts or fermentation of sulfurous mats is standard vent-shore ecology. A territorial Kiln forager eating mats plus tapping fumarole gas is energetically plausible as supplement, not sole autotrophy. Wind inversion blowing H₂S back is a real toxicity risk above ~100 ppm (F27).

body_plan.origin: Reptilian analog with heat-armor and chemical gut, convergent with arthropod exoskeleton for rigidity in heat.

secrets: Cenizo scales can be used as heat-shields; player can craft 'Thermal Armor'.
moments: A Cenizo stands in the Kiln as a flare washes over, its plates blazing white, pupils locking tight, while it exhales a plume of sulfur that hisses on the salt-crusted ground.

journal.en: The Kiln is a furnace that breathes.
